title: Railway Minister Leads Tiranga Rally at Rail Bhawan on the Eve of Independence Day
subtitle: Indian Railways Celebrates ‘Har Ghar Tiranga’ Campaign with Special Cultural Programmes on Patriotism
body_text:
The Union  Minister for Railways, Shri Ashwini Vaishnaw, led a Tiranga Rally within the premises of Rail Bhawan on the eve of Independence Day. Chairman & CEO, Railway Board, Shri Satish Kumar, Board Members, DGs and other senior officials participated in the rally, reaffirming the collective spirit of patriotism and national unity.
Indian Railways is actively participating in the nationwide ‘Har Ghar Tiranga’ campaign, celebrating the spirit of patriotism, national pride and unity across the railway organisation. The campaign is being organised in integration with the third phase of the commemoration of 150 years of ‘Vande Mataram’, with a series of programmes being organised at Rail Bhawan to highlight the historical, cultural and national significance of the iconic national song.
As part of the celebrations, a quiz competition on ‘150 Years Journey of Vande Mataram’ was also organised on 10 August 2026 at Rail Bhawan. The programme provided an opportunity for officials to engage with the rich history and enduring legacy of the national song.
A special cultural programme on ‘Patriotic Songs’ was organised on 11 August 2026 at Rail Bhawan. The programme witnessed enthusiastic participation and celebrated the spirit of patriotism through musical performances.
As part of the celebrations on 14 August 2026, a Mass Singing of ‘Vande Mataram’ was also organised at Rail Bhawan.
Celebrating Patriotism, Unity and National Pride
Through these programmes, Indian Railways is reinforcing the spirit of patriotism, national pride and unity among its officials and employees while commemorating the historic legacy of ‘Vande Mataram’. The celebrations under the ‘Har Ghar Tiranga’ campaign reflect the collective participation of Indian Railways in celebrating the nation’s heritage and its aspirations for a modern and progressive India.
***
Dharmendra Tewari/ Dr. Nayan Solanki/ Ritu Raj/ Vanshita Jaiswal

enrichment.summary: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw led a Tiranga Rally at Rail Bhawan on 14 August 2026, the eve of Independence Day, joined by the Railway Board Chairman, Board Members and senior officials. Indian Railways is participating in the nationwide 'Har Ghar Tiranga' campaign, integrated with the third phase of the 150 years of 'Vande Mataram' commemoration, through events including a quiz, a patriotic songs programme, and a mass singing of 'Vande Mataram'.
enrichment.context: This release documents a ceremonial and commemorative event tied to Independence Day celebrations and the ongoing 'Har Ghar Tiranga' campaign, a Government of India initiative encouraging citizens to display the national flag to foster patriotism. It is being linked here with the 150th anniversary commemorations of 'Vande Mataram', India's national song, composed by Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay in 1875 and adopted as the national song by the Constituent Assembly in 1950. Such internal departmental celebrations are routine across ministries around Independence Day and carry no policy or governance content.
